description: MCP server for alltcgapi: cards, sets, sealed products and current Cardmarket and TCGplayer prices across 19 trading card games.
rules: Cardmarket quotes are in EUR and TCGplayer quotes in USD: never add, average or convert them into one figure.
Quote every price with its source and its as_of date.
Card and sealed ids are UUIDs: find them with atcg_search_cards, atcg_list_set_cards or atcg_search_sealed.
Card name search matches the start of the name, ignoring case: retry with a shorter prefix before concluding a card is missing.
There is no price history, no graded price and no photo recognition.
